# SlainteTech AI Security Labs — Sovereign Healthcare AI & HL7 FHIR R4 Platform

> SlainteTech builds 11 autonomous clinical, governance, and cybersecurity health-tech agents governed by deterministic Python FastMCP guardrails on HL7 FHIR R4 across 8 responsive healthcare verticals (desktop, tablet, ambulance ePCR, and mobile care-at-home nursing).

## Core Architectural Principle
- **Zero Hallucinated Clinical Math**: Royal College of Physicians NEWS2 (0-20), Manchester Triage System (Cat 1-5), and 3-Tier Pharmacology (Allergy cross-reactivity, ISMP High-Alert DDI, LOINC eGFR & Potassium renal gating) execute 100% in deterministic Python FastMCP tools — never inside probabilistic LLM weights.
- **Sovereign & Air-Gap Capable**: Runs locally on 3B quantized Ollama models alongside SlainteFHIR (:8082) and FastMCP (:8081), or connects via BAA-gated cloud providers with GDPR Art. 9 pre-inference PII redaction.

## 8 Industry Verticals (`/verticals/<domain>/`)
- [For Emergency Departments (SlainteED)](/verticals/emergency-departments/): Deterministic MTS Cat 1-5, 24h RCP NEWS2 sepsis tracking, 3-Tier Rx-Guard, and cited consultant shift handovers.
- [For General Practitioners & Community Nursing (SlainteGP)](/verticals/general-practice/): Ambient Voice Scribe SOAP notes, HSE Chronic Disease Management, PCRS GMS export, and mobile smartphone/tablet UX for Care-at-Home Nurses.
- [For Psychiatrists & Mental Health (SlaintePsych)](/verticals/psychiatry/): Structured MSE composer, LOINC PHQ-9 (44261-6) & GAD-7 (70274-6) tracking, psychotropic renal/DDI screening, and GDPR Art. 9 compartment isolation.
- [For Dental Surgeons & DSOs (SlainteDent)](/verticals/dentistry/): Interactive 32-tooth FDI Odontogram (11-48), 6-sextant BPE charting, and chairside Penicillin/anticoagulant clearance.
- [For Clinical & Community Pharmacies (SlaintePharm)](/verticals/pharmacy/): Risk-sorted dispensing queue, 3-Tier pharmacology verification, PSI Provenance sign-off, and HSE PCRS claim export.
- [For Ambulance & Paramedic Services (SlainteEMS)](/verticals/ambulance-ems/): Glove-friendly 44px rugged tablet ePCR, sub-10ms MTS/NEWS2 acuity scoring, and 1-tap receiving ED FHIR R4 bundle push.
- [For Elite Sports Clubs & Federations (SlainteSport)](/verticals/sports-medicine/): Squad physiological readiness, SCAT6 concussion SHA-256 Return-to-Play Provenance, TUE screening, and BOLA athlete privacy.
- [For Astronaut & Aerospace Medicine (SlainteAstro)](/verticals/astronaut-health/): 100% air-gapped onboard autonomous medical bay running all 11 agents with zero Earth-cloud dependency.
